title: Cemetery Visit Coverage by Ancestor Line
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:cemetery ancestor_line=*
| stats count as items by ancestor_line
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how cemetery visits split across ancestor line for family-line coverage.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside family-line coverage.
implementation: Capture each cemetery visits event in `genealogy:cemetery` and normalize `ancestor_line` so Splunk can compute the share by ancestor line.
visualization: Table of ancestor line with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It records how cemetery visits are divided across ancestor line so you can tell if one part of family-line coverage is taking over.
